In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:
```go
	key := NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource)
	declared := searchFields.SelectableFields(key)
```
and pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go:
```go
func (r *SearchFieldsRegistry) SelectableFields(key LowerGroupResource) []string {
	if r == nil {
		return nil
	}
	r.mu.RLock()
	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
	return r.selectableFields[key]
}
```
The lookup uses `NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource)`, evaluating declarations for the specific kind rather than matching across the entire group.

In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:
```go
	if len(req.Options.Fields) == 0 {
		return true
	}
```
If there are no field selectors in `req.Options.Fields`, `shouldUseSearchForList` returns `true` without checking field declarations.

In pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go:
```go
	manifests := resource.MergeManifestsByKind(resource.AppManifests())
	selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders, err := resource.SearchFieldsForManifests(manifests...)
	if err != nil {
		return resource.SearchOptions{}, err
	}

	if docs == nil || !cfg.EnableSearch {
		searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders = nil, nil
	}

	searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)
...
	return resource.SearchOptions{
		EmbeddingConfig: embeddingConfig,
		SearchFields:    searchFields,
```
`SearchFields` is populated in `SearchOptions` outside the `if cfg.EnableSearch` block, ensuring it is provided even when local search is disabled.

In pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go:
```go
	if docs == nil || !cfg.EnableSearch {
		searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders = nil, nil
	}

	searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)
```
When `docs == nil`, `searchFieldsHashes` and `searchFieldsProviders` are set to `nil`, but `selectableFields` remains populated and passed to `NewSearchFieldsRegistry`.

### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Live Selectable Fields Verification in `shouldUseSearchForList`
- **File**: [`pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go)
- **Change**: Replaced the hardcoded check (`AppManifestsWithKinds(AppManifests()...)`) which only checked if `req.Options.Key.Group` was compiled into the binary. Now, [`shouldUseSearchForList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go#L371) queries the live [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L582) on the server for the resource (`NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource)`) and verifies that **every single field** in `req.Options.Fields` is in the declared selectable fields set.
- **Why**: Allows apps dynamically installed or updated at runtime to leverage search-backed field filtering without requiring a Grafana release. Also ensures that filtering on an undeclared field safely falls back to a full store scan rather than routing to the search index and returning empty results.

#### 2. Wiring `SearchFieldsRegistry` into `ResourceServer`
- **Files**: [`pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go), [`pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go)
- **Change**:
  - Added `SearchFields *SearchFieldsRegistry` to [`ResourceServerOptions`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L386) and stored it on [`server`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L712) in [`NewUninitializedResourceServer`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L545). If omitted, it defaults to `opts.Search.SearchFields` or a registry initialized with built-in selectable fields.
  - Added helper method [`SelectableFields`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L625) to [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L582) for thread-safe lookups.

#### 3. Support Across Deployment Modes (Including Delegated Search)
- **File**: [`pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go)
- **Change**: In [`NewSearchOptions`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go#L49), initialized and set `SearchFields` on the returned [`SearchOptions`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L330) even when local Bleve search is disabled (`!cfg.EnableSearch`).
- **Why**: In architectures where storage delegates search queries to an external service (`searchClient`), the storage server still serves `List` requests and requires access to the live `SearchFieldsRegistry` (kept up-to-date by the `ManifestWatcher`) to make consistent routing decisions.

#### 4. Mapping Normalized Resource Names
- **File**: [`pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go)
- **Change**: Ensured [`selectableFieldsForManifest`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L52) maps both `ManifestResourceName(v)` as well as `v.Plural` and `v.Kind`, ensuring lookups succeed regardless of whether the manifest omits the explicit plural definition.

#### 5. Tests
- **File**: [`pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go)
- **Change**:
  - Updated [`TestShouldUseSearchForList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go#L23) to support configuring `searchFields`.
  - Added test cases verifying:
    - Lists filtering on declared selectable fields route to search.
    - Lists filtering on undeclared fields on known resources reject search and fall back to store.

  - Added [`TestListFallsBackToStoreWhenFieldNotDeclared`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-bench/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-1/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go#L987) to verify end-to-end fallback when field is undeclared.
